basis: Revolution-weighted equivalent radial load; repeated identical duty cycle; basic L10 is a 90%-survival population fatigue rating, not an individual lifetime prediction.
limitations: Illustrative pure-radial P=Fr only. No axial loads, real load diagrams, catalog X/Y factors, static capacity, minimum-load or skidding checks, lubrication/contamination, shock transients, adjusted ISO rating life, field reliability or RUL validation. Segment fractions assume time at positive constant speeds; zero-rpm intervals are unsupported. Damage fraction is a model ratio, not an observed damage measurement or failure probability.
